content: {"question":"Where should I create an issue for onboarding, offboarding, or transition questions?","answer":"In the Employment Issue Tracker subproject.","evidence":"[**Employment Issue Tracker**](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/people-group/people-operations/employment-templates): Only Onboarding, Offboarding and Transition Issue Templates are held in this subproject, and they are created by the People Operations Team only."}
